tools.name: gas-optimizer
tools.description: Gas ONLY: live Base Mainnet gas from eth_feeHistory — latest and 10-block average base fee (gwei), priority-fee percentiles (p25/p50/p75) and a congestion label. Use this when you need gas and nothing else; if you also want WETH/USDC pricing, use market-snapshot instead (one cheaper call). Price: 0.

tools.name: dex-arbitrage
tools.description: DEX pricing/spread ONLY: WETH/USDC spot price on-chain from Uniswap v3 and Aerodrome v2, with gross spread in bps and which side is cheaper (fees, gas and slippage excluded). Use this for cross-DEX pricing; for expected slippage of a given trade size use pool-slippage; if you also need gas use marke

tools.name: whale-wallet-tracker
tools.description: Large USDC transfers on Base over the most recent blocks (default ~300), from confirmed Transfer logs: amount, sender, receiver, tx hash, block. Price: 0.0100 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: flash-loans
tools.description: Aave v3 on Base: available flash-loan liquidity and flash-loan fee for any listed asset (default WETH), read on-chain. Price: 0.0050 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: liquidity-health
tools.description: Token risk flags ONLY: for an ERC-20 on Base (honeypot, tax over 10%, mintable, unverified source, hidden owner, pausable...) from GoPlus plus on-chain facts (symbol, supply, owner). No safety verdict; no flags is not a guarantee. For a full check that ALSO adds contract/proxy facts and pool liquidi

tools.name: liquidation-monitor
tools.description: Aave v3 on Base: total collateral, debt, health factor and risk band (LIQUIDATABLE / AT_RISK / WATCH / HEALTHY / NO_DEBT) for any wallet. Price: 0.0050 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: token-deploy-radar
tools.description: Newest Uniswap v3 pools created on Base (PoolCreated events) with token symbols, fee tier and block. A new pool does not imply a legitimate token. Price: 0.0050 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: token-due-diligence
tools.description: FULL token check (BUNDLE): combines GoPlus risk flags (= liquidity-health) + contract/proxy/owner facts (= contract-profile) + Uniswap v3 pools vs WETH/USDC with quote-side liquidity in USD, in a single call. Objective signals, not a verdict. Use this instead of calling liquidity-health and contract

tools.name: contract-profile
tools.description: Contract structure ONLY: bytecode size, proxy detection (EIP-1167 / EIP-1967 implementation and admin) and owner() for any address on Base. NOT a security audit. For a full token check that also adds risk flags and pool liquidity, use token-due-diligence; to read an arbitrary view function use contr

tools.name: token-spot-price
tools.description: Price of ONE token: on-chain USD spot price for a single ERC-20 on Base, from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool vs USDC/WETH (slot0), with the pool/fee tier used and its USD depth. No off-chain feed; thin pools are easy to manipulate. To price MANY tokens at once, use multi-token-price instead (one cheape

tools.name: wallet-portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio of a wallet on Base: native ETH plus a curated set of major ERC-20s (USDC, WETH, cbETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC), each valued in USD on-chain via Uniswap v3. Returns per-token amounts, USD values and the total. Price: 0.0040 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: market-snapshot
tools.description: BUNDLE: one-call Base market snapshot combining live gas (base fee, priority-fee percentiles, congestion) AND WETH/USDC spot price + gross spread across Uniswap v3 / Aerodrome. Use this when you want both gas and DEX pricing in a single cheaper call; do NOT also call gas-optimizer or dex-arbitrage f

tools.name: aave-yield
tools.description: Live Aave v3 reserve rates on Base read on-chain: current supply APY and variable borrow APY for any listed asset (default WETH). For yield and borrow-cost bots. Price: 0.0040 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: multi-token-price
tools.description: Price of MANY tokens (BATCH): on-chain USD spot price for up to 15 ERC-20s in one call, each from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool vs USDC/WETH. Tokens with no pool return an error entry. Use this for 2+ tokens; for a single token use token-spot-price (cheaper). Price: 0.0080 USDC per call (premium: alwa

tools.name: pool-slippage
tools.description: Estimated price impact / slippage for a WETH/USDC trade of a given USD size on Uniswap v3, from on-chain pool depth. Order-of-magnitude signal (v3 is concentrated liquidity), useful for MEV/execution bots before trading. Price: 0.0050 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

tools.name: contract-read
tools.description: Generic read-only call to any contract on Base: provide an address and hex calldata (4-byte selector, e.g. 0x18160ddd = totalSupply, optionally followed by ABI-encoded args) and get the raw return data plus best-effort uint/address/bool/string decoding. Read-only (never sends a transaction). Use thi

tools.name: contract-logs
tools.description: Recent event logs for any contract on Base over a bounded recent window (reads eth_getLogs). Optionally filter by topic0 (event signature hash). Returns up to 50 logs with block, tx hash, topics and data. Window is limited by the RPC log-range quota. Use this for generic event queries not covered by

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "contract-read" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Tool "whale-wallet-tracker" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Price: 0.0100 USDC per call (premium: always paid)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
